annotations.title: Subtitle tools: convert, retime, merge and read caption files

description: Subtitle tools: convert, retime, merge and read caption files. Use when a task involves a subtitle or caption file: converting between SubRip (.srt), WebVTT (.vtt), ASS/SSA and YouTube SBV, shifting timings or rescaling them for a frame-rate change (23.976 to 25 and back), merging several files onto one timeline, pulling a plain-text transcript out of captions, or reporting a file's cue count, duration and reading speed. The converted file comes back in result_text; the info operation leaves result_text empty and answers in the info block. Send the file as text, as a public URL, or as base64 up to 4 MB. Cost: 1 credit per call.

file_base64.description: The caption file as base64, up to 4 MB.

files.description: The files to merge onto one timeline. merge only.

from_format.description: auto (default), srt, vtt, ass or sbv.

merge_gap_seconds.description: Gap to leave between files, for operation merge.

offset_seconds.description: Seconds to shift every cue, for operation shift.

operation.description: convert (default), shift, merge, to_text or info.

scale.description: Timing multiplier for a frame-rate change, for operation shift.

strip_tags.description: Drop styling tags from the cue text.

text.description: The caption file as text. Not allowed with operation merge.

to_format.description: srt, vtt, ass or sbv. Required for convert; refused for info and to_text.

url.description: A public http(s) URL to read the caption file from.

name: subtitle_tools
